properties.description: Common pre-reaction van der Waals pi-complex used as the single reference for BOTH channels (s-cis cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile, one node). Delivered geometry: shortest inter-fragment contacts d(map2,map6)=3.24 A and d(map4,map7)=3.27 A, dienophile C6=C7 still 1.34 A, diene C1=C2 1.36 A / C4=C5 1.35 A / C1-C5 1.47 A (diene intact, s-cis). Normal termination, 0 imaginary frequencies. A second conformer of the same complex reached by the endo IRC (-364.69808167 Ha, 0.44 kcal/mol higher, ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0006/reactant_frequency/reactant_frequency.log) is documented as a conformer, not promoted to a second reference; the lower one fixes both barriers.

Endo concerted [4+2] saddle (first-order, single imaginary mode -457.24 cm-1 along the coupled C2-C6/C4-C7 forming motion; pair projections 0.966/0.750): forming bonds 2.100 and 2.381 A (asynchronous), diene/dienophile bonds 1.40-1.43 A. Nitrile carbon to C5 = 3.02 A, to C1 = 3.54 A, to the one-carbon bridge C3 = 3.80 A: the nitrile sits on the C=C face, under the diene pi system (endo approach).
properties.smiles_note: The 'smiles: C1=CCC=C1.C=CC#N' comment line in this saddle's Gaussian input/log denotes the REACTING SYSTEM (reactant complex -> product), not a species identity; a first-order saddle has no valid SMILES, which is why this node declares smiles: [].

properties.description: Exo concerted [4+2] saddle (first-order, single imaginary mode -457.13 cm-1 along the coupled C2-C6/C4-C7 forming motion; pair projections 0.996/0.762): forming bonds 2.098 and 2.385 A (asynchronous). Nitrile carbon to C5 = 3.86 A, to C1 = 4.28 A, to the one-carbon bridge C3 = 3.08 A: the nitrile points toward the one-carbon bridge and away from the diene pi system (exo approach), the mirror of the endo saddle.
properties.smiles_note: The 'smiles: C1=CCC=C1.C=CC#N' comment line in this saddle's Gaussian input/log denotes the REACTING SYSTEM (reactant complex -> product), not a species identity; a first-order saddle has no valid SMILES, which is why this node declares smiles: [].

properties.description: endo-2-cyanobicyclo[2.2.1]hept-5-ene. Adduct bonds 1.56/1.58 (new C-C), 1.57 (C6-C7), 1.34 (C1=C5 ring double bond), 1.46 A. Nitrile carbon to C5 = 2.93 A, to C1 = 3.51 A, to the one-carbon bridge C3 = 3.72 A: the short transannular contact is on the C=C face, i.e. the endo diastereomer by the IUPAC endo/exo convention. Normal termination, 0 imaginary frequencies; canonical isomeric SMILES regenerated from this 3D geometry is identical to the declared one.

exo-2-cyanobicyclo[2.2.1]hept-5-ene. Adduct bonds 1.56/1.58, 1.57, 1.34, 1.46 A (as for the endo adduct). Nitrile carbon to C5 = 3.78 A, to C1 = 4.23 A, to the one-carbon bridge C3 = 3.09 A: the short contact is on the C3 bridge side, i.e. the exo diastereomer - the exact mirror of the endo geometric criterion. Normal termination, 0 imaginary frequencies; canonical isomeric SMILES regenerated from this 3D geometry is identical to the declared one.
